scoring_notes: Scores start at 50 and are not capped. Rent: +15 at or under $4,500, plus up to +5 more scaling linearly toward $3,000 (the full +5 at $3,000 or less); +5 for $4,500–$5,000; −10 above $5,000. Beach walk uses a routed pedestrian time to the nearest sand-side access point along the coast from El Segundo Beach (Grand Ave) to Torrance Beach: ≤5 min +20, ≤10 +15, ≤15 +10, ≤20 +5, >20 −25. Drive to 1 Rocket Rd, Hawthorne uses the rush-hour estimate (OSRM free-flow × 1.4; OSRM has no live traffic): ≤20 min +10, ≤25 +3, beyond that −5. Home type: SINGLE_FAMILY +12, TOWNHOUSE +8, MULTI_FAMILY +4, CONDO +2, others 0. Size: +3 if 1,100 sq ft or more. Verified details: cats allowed +5; no pets −60 and status rejected; 2+ parking spaces or a 2-car garage +5; only 1 space −8; unvetted (cats_ok and parking both 'unknown') −3. Freshness from days on market: 0–1 days +16, 2–3 +12, 4–7 +8, 8–14 +4. Listings more than 14 days old, or with listed_date more than 14 days before today, are marked stale and left unranked. Rank is 1..n by score among listings whose status is not rejected, stale, or off_market; those three statuses have rank null. Walk and drive times come from the FOSSGIS public OSRM servers. drive_min_to_spacex is OSRM free-flow; drive_min_to_spacex_rush is free-flow × 1.4 and is the figure used for scoring.
